properties.name: A server holding many designs starts with enough file handles for every design it may hold open, and says so when they do not fit
properties.source: Anthony Sligar, 2026-10-28: "Go with your recommendation" (options A and B of the open question on the three limits)
properties.statement: When a server that holds many designs starts, it raises its own open-file limit as far as the host allows. It then checks the most designs it may hold open, times the files each one may keep open, plus the server's own files, against that limit. When they do not fit, it says so at start in plain words, naming the three numbers and which one to change. It warns and keeps running rather than refusing to start, because a server whose designs are small works fine below the worst case.
